urdu.name: جمعہ
urdu.long_meaning: Jumaa (جمعہ) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم جمعہ، جمعے کا دن ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

pashto.long_meaning: Jumaa (جمعه) د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی او بنسټیزه مانا یې جمعه، د جمعې ورځ ده. دا نوم په مسلمانانو ټولنو کې کارول کیږي او کارونه یې د سیاق له مخې بدلیږي.

arabic.long_meaning: Jumaa (جمعة) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العربية، ومعناه الأساسي الجمعة، يوم الجماعة. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.

faq.a: Jumaa is associated with the Arabic form جمعة, whose core sense is friday; the day of congregation.

faq.q: What is the origin of Jumaa?
faq.a: Jumaa is associated with Arabic. Jumaa is Arabic جُمُعَة (Jumuʿa) 'Friday; the day of congregation', from the root ج م ع (j-m-ʿ). The source gloss 'Friday, Congregation' is consistent. Same name as jumah and jumaat.
Yes — the underlying form جمعة is Arabic.
Jumaa can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.q: What does Jumaa mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Jumaa is rendered جمعہ and carries the sense جمعہ، جمعے کا دن.

faq.q: What does Jumaa mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Jumaa is rendered جمعه and carries the sense جمعه، روز آدینه.
A romanized syllable approximation is ju-maa. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Jumaa?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Jumaa, juma, jumaa. Script forms are جمعة, جمعه, جمعہ, जुमा.

faq.q: Is Jumaa a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
